mapper.select: select id, account_id, purpose, storage_provider, bucket, object_key, original_name, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, width, height, status, rights_notice_version from p_file where account_id = #{accountId} and id = #{fileId} and purpose = 'AVATAR_SOURCE' and status = 'AVAILABLE'
mapper.sql: id, account_id, avatar_id, avatar_version_id, source_file_id, quota_reservation_id, request_id, status, internal_state, progress, error_code, created_at
mapper.select: select from p_generation_task where account_id = #{accountId} and request_id = #{requestId}
select from p_generation_task where account_id = #{accountId} and id = #{taskId}
select from p_generation_task where account_id = #{accountId} order by created_at desc, id desc limit 100

select id, name, provider_code, endpoint, model_id, parameters, revision from p_official_service where id = #{serviceId} and capability = 'AVATAR_GENERATION' and status = 'ACTIVE' and provider_code = 'DASHSCOPE_IMAGE' and model_id = 'qwen-image-3.0-pro'

select id as serviceId, name, provider_code as providerCode, model_id as modelId, revision from p_official_service where capability = 'AVATAR_GENERATION' and status = 'ACTIVE' and provider_code = 'DASHSCOPE_IMAGE' and model_id = 'qwen-image-3.0-pro' order by name, id
mapper.update: update p_quota_balance set reserved_units = reserved_units + 1, revision = revision + 1, updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where account_id = #{accountId} and quota_type = 'AVATAR_COUNT' and reserved_units < granted_units - used_units
mapper.insert: insert into p_file (id, created_at, updated_at, account_id, purpose, storage_provider, bucket, object_key, original_name, content_type, size_bytes, sha256, width, height, status, rights_notice_version, rights_confirmed_at, confirmed_by) values (#{id}, utc_timestamp(3), utc_timestamp(3), #{accountId}, #{purpose}, #{storageProvider}, #{bucket}, #{objectKey}, #{originalName}, #{contentType}, #{sizeBytes}, #{sha256}, #{width}, #{height}, #{status}, #{rightsNoticeVersion}, utc_timestamp(3), #{accountId})
insert into p_avatar (id, created_at, updated_at, account_id, visibility, name, status, revision) values (#{id}, utc_timestamp(3), utc_timestamp(3), #{accountId}, #{visibility}, #{name}, 'DRAFT', 1)

insert into p_avatar_version (id, created_at, updated_at, account_id, avatar_id, version_no, status, source_type, source_file_id, pipeline_version, generation_recipe, capabilities, qa_report, created_by) values (#{id}, utc_timestamp(3), utc_timestamp(3), #{accountId}, #{avatarId}, 1, 'BUILDING', 'IMAGE', #{sourceFileId}, #{pipelineVersion}, cast(#{generationRecipe} as json), json_object(), json_object(), #{accountId})

insert into p_quota_reservation (id, created_at, updated_at, account_id, quota_type, business_type, business_id, reservation_no, reserved_units, settled_units, state) values (#{id}, utc_timestamp(3), utc_timestamp(3), #{accountId}, 'AVATAR_COUNT', 'GENERATION', #{businessId}, 1, 0, 0, 'RESERVED')

insert into p_quota_entry (id, created_at, updated_at, account_id, quota_type, reservation_id, event_key, entry_type, delta_granted, delta_used, delta_reserved) values (#{id}, utc_timestamp(3), utc_timestamp(3), #{accountId}, 'AVATAR_COUNT', #{reservationId}, #{eventKey}, 'RESERVE', 0, 0, 0)

insert into p_generation_task (id, created_at, updated_at, account_id, avatar_id, avatar_version_id, source_file_id, task_kind, status, internal_state, progress, official_service_id, service_snapshot, pipeline_version, quota_reservation_id, request_id, request_hash, reservation_no) values (#{id}, utc_timestamp(3), utc_timestamp(3), #{accountId}, #{avatarId}, #{avatarVersionId}, #{sourceFileId}, 'GENERATE', 'QUEUED', 'READY', 0, #{officialServiceId}, cast(#{serviceSnapshot} as json), #{pipelineVersion}, #{quotaReservationId}, #{requestId}, #{requestHash}, 1)

insert into p_generation_step (id, created_at, updated_at, account_id, task_id, step_key, step_type, action_code, depends_on, status, stage_started_at, attempt_no, reserved_attempt_id, lease_epoch, next_run_at) values (#{id}, utc_timestamp(3), utc_timestamp(3), #{accountId}, #{taskId}, #{stepKey}, 'GENERATE_ACTION', #{actionCode}, json_array(), 'READY', utc_timestamp(3), 0, #{reservedAttemptId}, 0, utc_timestamp(3))

insert into p_outbox (id, created_at, updated_at, account_id, event_id, event_type, aggregate_type, aggregate_id, schema_version, trace_id, payload, status, attempt_count, next_run_at) values (#{id}, utc_timestamp(3), utc_timestamp(3), #{accountId}, #{eventId}, #{eventType}, #{aggregateType}, #{aggregateId}, 1, #{traceId}, cast(#{payload} as json), 'PENDING', 0, utc_timestamp(3))
